```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, error = FALSE, echo = FALSE)
```

```{r lib_load}
library(tidyverse)   # data wrangling & ggplot2
library(janitor)     # functions for examining and cleaning dirty data
library(kableExtra)  # simple table generator
library(here)        # Find files within a project
library(olsrr)       # package for p-value backward elimination
library(broom)       # summarizes key information about models
library(rlang)       # functions for Base Types and Core R and 'Tidyverse' Features
library(car)         # VIF, influence measures helpers
library(scales)      # provides the internal scaling infrastructure used by ggplot
library(effects)     # Effect Displays for Linear, Generalized Linear, and Other Models
```

```{r fun, results='hide'}
codf     <- readRDS(file = here("rmds/modfunctions", "codfunctions.rds"))
codform  <- readRDS(file = here("rmds", "codformulas.rds"))
codf_env <- list2env(codf, parent = globalenv())
for (nm in names(codf)) {environment(codf[[nm]]) <- codf_env}
list2env(codf, envir = codf_env)
source(here("rmds/cod2325/districtruns/d2325f", "spss_cod_district-7_23-25f.R"), local = knitr::knit_global())
```

```{r setup1}
data_path <- here("data/city", "CCD7_2023-2025_Data.sav")  
ecf_keep <- NULL       # Optional: add ECF filters here if needed
base_ecf <- "7r709"    # Base ECF in the SPSS syntax
cook_case_count <- 2668
forced_terms <- character(0)

load(file = here("data/rdata", "cod_2023-2025geo.RData"))
load(file = here("rmds/cod2325/districtruns/dmods", "spss_cod_district-6_23-25_June2.RData"))
load(file = here("rmds/cod2325/districtruns/dmods", "spss_cod_district-6_23-25geo_July21.RData"))
```

## Model I

```{r mod1gcm}
mcomp <- make_metrics_kable_lm(
  spss_mod = d6_mod_time_23_25_June2, spss_label = "Control", r_label = "+ Geospatial",
  r_mod = d6_mod_time_23_25geo_July21, pct_label = "% Difference",
  caption = "Model Metrics: LN-SPPSF Model Comparison", include_aic_bic = TRUE, digits = 4
)
mcomp$kable
```

```{r mod1gca}
ratio_comp <- make_ratio_metrics_kable_lm(
  spss_mod = d6_mod_time_23_25_June2, spss_label = "Control", r_label = "+ Geospatial",
  r_mod = d6_mod_time_23_25geo_July21, pct_label = "% Difference",
  caption = "Ratio Metrics: LN-SPPSF Model Comparison",
  response_is_logged = TRUE
  # For a log-normal correction: correction_factor_r = exp(0.5 * sigma(mod_r)^2)
)
ratio_comp$kable
```

## Model Comparison

```{r coef7, eval=FALSE}
res_extreme <- summarize_extreme_betas_kable(
  mod_time, mod_no_ecf, mod_1, mod_2, mod_3, mod_4,
  model_names = c("M1", "M2", "M3", "M4", "M5", "M6"),
  top_n = 3,
  bottom_n = 3,
  caption = "Top and Bottom Standardized Beta Predictors across Models"
)

res_extreme$kable
```

```{r blp7}
res_beta7 <- plot_avg_beta_lollipop_6model(
  d6_mod_time_23_25_June2, d6_mod_ln_price_no_ecf_23_25_June2,
  d6_mod_base_23_25_June2, d6_mod_base_inliers_23_25_June2,
  d6_mod_tasp_23_25_June2, d6_mod_alt_23_25_June2, include_ecf = FALSE,
  model_names = c("M1", "M2", "M3", "M4", "M5", "M6"), top_n = 5,
  title = "District 6 | Avg Std Beta across Initial Models"
)
res_beta7$plot
```

```{r blp8}
res_beta8 <- plot_avg_beta_lollipop_6model(
  d6_mod_time_23_25geo_July21, d6_mod_ln_price_no_ecf_23_25geo_July21,
  d6_mod_base_23_25geo_July21, d6_mod_base_inliers_23_25geo_July21,
  d6_mod_tasp_23_25geo_July21, d6_mod_alt_23_25geo_July21, include_ecf = FALSE,
  model_names = c("M1", "M2", "M3", "M4", "M5", "M6"), top_n = 5,
  title = "District 6 | Avg Std Beta across Geospatial Models"
)
res_beta8$plot
```

```{r modsav, eval=FALSE}
d6_mod_time_23_25geo_July21 <- mod_time
d6_mod_ln_price_no_ecf_23_25geo_July21 <- mod_no_ecf
d6_mod_base_23_25geo_July21 <- mod_1
d6_mod_base_inliers_23_25geo_July21 <- mod_2
d6_mod_tasp_23_25geo_July21 <- mod_3
d6_mod_alt_23_25geo_July21 <- mod_4

save(d6_mod_time_23_25geo_July21, d6_mod_ln_price_no_ecf_23_25geo_July21,
     d6_mod_base_23_25geo_July21, d6_mod_base_inliers_23_25geo_July21,
     d6_mod_tasp_23_25geo_July21, d6_mod_alt_23_25geo_July21,
     file = here("rmds/cod2325/districtruns/dmods", "spss_cod_district-7_23-25geo_July21.RData"))
```

## Prediction Testing

```{r mod1apreds}
res_dev1a <- summarize_saleprice_deviation_kable(
  model = d6_mod_time_23_25_June2,
  data = df6,
  title = "Deviation Summary: Initial LN-SPPSF Model",
  response_type = "sppsf",
  response_is_logged = TRUE,
  floorarea_col = "sresb_floorarea"
)
res_dev1a$kable
```

```{r mod1bpreds}
res_dev1b <- summarize_saleprice_deviation_kable(
  model = d6_mod_time_23_25geo_July21,
  data = df6,
  title = "Deviation Summary: LN-SPPSF Model + Geospatials",
  response_type = "sppsf",

res_dev1b$kable
```
